itemEvidence.finalSql:
-- 以订单表最大购买时间为锚，取最后 90 天按周汇总 order_items 销售额
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts FROM orders
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS week,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
CROSS JOIN anchor a
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= a.max_ts - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= a.max_ts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;
